scope: D-093 / current static plan 5a only. Same coherent sine from unit start, nominal flash thresholds, matched static auxiliary, Q3/Q1.10/Q22, original gates/steps/120-slot synchronous commits. Comparator offsets, input switch, dynamics and new algorithm remain separate next tasks.
parameter_provenance: Minimal already-seen EXP057/059 nominal subset: ideal positive control, both-stage linear and both-stage smooth. Synthetic mechanism assumptions, no chip fit or independent curve holdout. Original numeric kernels reused unchanged.

input.formula: x[n]=0.82*sin(2*pi*127*(n mod30720)/30720). Stored one-period double table is the declared source; integer modulo is phase reduction, not a reset at evaluation. No input/PRNG/state pause at block boundaries.

dither: Original independent counter streams 2 and 3, indexed by global conversion n, +/-1 with physical amplitudes1/32 at both preamp summing nodes. Periodic input is independent of declared tags; IID independence is a modeling assumption, not a proven property of SplitMix64/chip PRNG.

budget.comparison: same conversions and commits; full uses30x learning observations/products. Do not imply equal hardware cost or same-learning endpoint.

verification.long_probe_schedule: first4 windows of each listed block plus final4 windows; all120 conversions in each probe, both old states, rational readout/commit and original fixed bank commit. 32 windows/stream.
verification.all_digital_replay: Independent signed integer nearest-even Q3/Q1.10/Q22 vector replay of EVERY stored conversion output and EVERY commit, selected/all-conversion support and update counters. Physical source checked against original platform at predeclared probes only; all stored tags independently regenerated and words checked against separate vector physical formulas.

empirical_convergence.coordinates: each coordinate with nonzero selected gate-and-basis support in the three-group interval; unsupported coordinates explicitly listed, not called converged
empirical_convergence.definition: first end of three consecutive nonoverlapping8-block groups with SNDR group mean range<=1dB and each supported effective coefficient group mean range<=0.005. Retrospective offline descriptor only, not online stopping; report subsequent violations and total passing intervals. Does not require positive net benefit and does not prove stationarity.

tail.policy: all latter-half window states; population covariance,8-block group drift and temporal correlations. Per-block actual outputs and net gains retained. No iid confidence interval or eight-state stationary-law claim.

evaluation: Save all digital source words plus unit unupdated / point / full final nearest-even12-bit codes from first conversion. Each30720-conversion rectangular coherent block: integer MSE/DC/SNDR/SFDR and exact MSE improvement identity with unit reference, including cross. Startup block is a transient spectrum, not a steady-state claim. Never freeze/pause updates for FFT. Save selected and all-conversion gates/basis/joint, correlation sums, hidden/export changes and zero requests by block. Nominal threshold baseline only.
predictions: Unit ideal output is an exact positive control. Four-point periodic phase occupation need not equal full occupation even after multiplying30. More support or empirical stability does not guarantee net benefit. Finite MSE/spectral cross identities must close; no preset performance ordering or expected convergence gate.
freeze: Refuse output overwrite, copy protocol/source protocol and hash executable sources plus original core/RTL before preflight. Long run requires passed preflight with same executable hashes. Freeze horizon/criteria before either run, no post-result extension or tuning. Online accumulation receives only digital values and old state, never input/analog/target/convergence score. Run files ignored by Git. No commit/push.
